games.name: 🏥 Hospital Map! | Blox Hunt v3.2.0
games.desc:
Check out Blox Hunt's sequel, Hide N' Find! https://www.roblox.com/games/4653158113/Hide-N-Find

Blox Hunt is a hide and seek style game with a twist: you become objects to hide in with the surroundings. 

Players are randomly selected to become Hiders and Seekers. The Hiders must blend in with the environment in order to avoid capture from the Seekers. If caught, they become a Seeker. The game ends if every Hider becomes a Seeker or the time runs out.

LIMITED TIME CODE (x3 SPINS AND 500 CASH): BUGSFIXED

Camo or Snipe is a game similar to hide & seek, but with a twist. Hiders camouflage themselves in their surroundings, while seekers use sniper rifles to track them down and eliminate them!

games.name: [ UPD66 // 🐉 ]Re:Trials
games.desc:
///// 🌾 Re:Write your fate 🌾 ///// Gameplay: the game starts in capital city, follows the storyline until arc 3, you need to deal with bosses such as white whale and petelgeuse while traveling with ground dragons.

🌊 Combat: Game offers a combat system with 9 different authorities, 7 different magics, 13 unique weapons for players to choose who to become, and there are currently 26 races and 9 divine protections in the game.

🌿 Grind: Game follows a simple grinding system, you need to defeat bosses and mabeasts across the map to gain experience, players can either prestige or stay at lower levels on their will. Each authority has an unique obtainment, making it feel like players are actually representing them.

Active code: [“675KVISITS”], [“Hero”] - grants 60 total race rerolls.
